messages:
lina: FYI saw a cluster of short reconnects from our EU-west websocket gateway. pattern: keepalive delayed ~250-800ms during node safepoint, clients retry aggressively and we end up with rapid resume attempts.
omar: Any example logs? ws or sse?
lina: WS. sample: 
```
[2026-03-24T09:44:10Z] gateway=node-euw-7 pause=430ms route=/v1/streams/chat user=uid:42
[2026-03-24T09:44:11Z] client=android-5 reconnect=fast reason=keepalive_miss resume=token:abc
```
marta: The bad bit is billing treats the resumed handshake as a separate session until resume ack lands. We saw a billing spike for that tenant.
omar: Short-term mitigations: 1) emit a tiny post-pause probe on gateway so clients see activity sooner; 2) SDK: add a 150-350ms randomized jitter before reconnect; 3) runtime: widen resume-grace to 400ms behind FF.
marta: Telemetry gap: console only shows aggregate reconnect_count. we need a "burst_reconnects" metric (same token reconnects within 2s) + client-agent breakdown.
console-team: We can add a compact panel: burst_count, median burst size, offending routes. also add an audit trail for per-route grace changes.
ops-bot: Note for rollout: feature flag gate required. recommend canary on 1 AZ first. add alert: burst_count > 3x baseline triggers pager.
lina: Action list:
- gateway: add post-pause probe canary on EU-west (omar)
- runtime: feature-flag resume grace bump to 400ms + CI test for simulated pause (marta)
- sdk: reconnect jitter PR (lina)
- console: add burst_reconnects panel + guardrail UX (console-team)

omar: I'll land a small probe patch and coordinate with infra. marta, can you own the billing dedupe spec? we need to avoid undercharging when resume fails.
marta: I'll draft a dedupe rule: if resume_token matches and requests start < 2s apart, soft-dedupe billing unless tokens_generated > 150.
console-team: UX note: when teams change grace value show "investigate node GC frequency" helptext. prevent >2000ms without extra approvals.
lina: thanks. will open SDK PR and link here. keep the canary small. :thumbsup:
